description: Push a file to all hosts in an asset group simultaneously. Optionally run a post-write command on each host.

file_content.label: File Content
file_content.description: File to distribute, base64-encoded by the frontend.

post_command.label: Post-Write Command
post_command.description: Optional shell command run on each host after the file is written, e.g. 'systemctl reload nginx'.

asset_group.label: Target Asset Group
asset_group.description: Tag name or explicit asset ID list.

rollback.description: No automatic rollback. Operator must redistribute the prior version.
